name: GM-Encoder
description: VMAF-targeted video encoder as a watch-folder daemon. Drop videos in the input share and it finds the optimal CRF for your target quality (terranvigil/dynamic-crf + ffmpeg/libvmaf), encodes, and remuxes all audio/subtitle/attachment/chapter streams from the original. Pick the encoder from the Codec dropdown, or leave it on 'auto' to detect the passed-through GPU. Supports NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD/Intel VAAPI and CPU. GPU ACCESS is controlled by Extra Parameters (below): - NVIDIA : --runtime=nvidia --device /dev/dri:/dev/dri/ (needs Nvidia-Driver plugin) - Intel/AMD (QSV/VAAPI) : --device /dev/dri:/dev/dri/ - CPU only : leave Extra Parameters empty

paths.name: Input share
paths.description: Drop videos here to encode (scanned recursively).

ports.name: Web GUI port
ports.description: Open http://UNRAID-IP:PORT for the control panel (settings, live progress, manual encode, pause/stop).

variables.name: Codec / GPU
variables.description: Pick your GPU vendor (nvidia/intel/amd/cpu) and it combines with Family below. auto = detect it. Or pick an explicit encoder. Make sure Extra Parameters passes the matching device/runtime.

variables.name: Codec family
variables.description: Combined with the GPU vendor above (e.g. nvidia + hevc = hevc_nvenc). hevc = best support, av1 = smallest (needs newer GPU), h264 = most compatible.

variables.name: Optimize (VMAF search)
variables.description: true = find the best CRF for the VMAF target. false = fixed quality (Manual CRF).

variables.name: VMAF minimum
variables.description: Minimum acceptable quality 0-100 (accepts anything from this up to 100; picks the smallest file that still meets it). 95 = archival, 93 = high (recommended), 90 = smaller.

variables.name: Initial CRF
variables.description: Search starting point.

variables.name: Min CRF (worst)
variables.description: Highest CRF number the search may use.

variables.name: Max CRF (best)
variables.description: Lowest CRF number the search may use.

variables.name: Manual CRF/QP
variables.description: Used only when Optimize = false.

variables.name: Scale height
variables.description: 0 = keep source resolution. e.g. 1080 downscales to 1080p.

variables.name: Remux original streams
variables.description: Copy all audio/subs/attachments/chapters from the source.

variables.name: Output container
variables.description: Output file type.

variables.name: Output suffix
variables.description: Appended to the filename.

variables.name: Output subdirectory
variables.description: SAME_AS_SRC = mirror the input folder structure. Empty = flat into /output. Or a fixed folder name.

variables.name: Auto watch-folder
variables.description: true = auto-encode files dropped in the input share. false = GUI/manual only (you pick files in the web UI).

variables.name: After success
variables.description: What to do with the source after a successful encode. move = to input/done.

variables.name: Keep larger output
variables.description: false = discard the result if it is not smaller than the source.

variables.name: Poll interval (s)
variables.description: How often to scan the input share.

variables.name: File stable (s)
variables.description: Wait this long after the last write before encoding (avoids partial copies).

variables.name: Scan existing on start
variables.description: Process files already present when the container starts.

variables.name: Input extensions
variables.description: Comma-separated list of file types to watch.

variables.name: VAAPI render device
variables.description: For *_vaapi codecs. Auto-falls back to the first real render node if this one is absent (Arc is often renderD129).

variables.name: LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME
variables.description: Intel/AMD QSV/VAAPI only. iHD = Intel Arc / recent iGPU, radeonsi = AMD. Leave empty to auto-detect. NOTE: pass /dev/dri via --device=/dev/dri in Extra Parameters, NOT as a Path mapping.

variables.name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
variables.description: Your GPU UUID from the Nvidia-Driver plugin page (e.g. GPU-xxxxxxxx-...), or 'all'.

variables.name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
variables.description: Leave as 'all' for NVENC.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User id for output files (Unraid = 99).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group id for output files (Unraid = 100).

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: File creation mask.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone.
